skills.name: PM项目复盘教练+笔记沉淀系统

skills.description: Smart context compression with four coordinated layers — auto pressure sensing (v3: fires after every tool call when the skill is loaded; v3.5 adds a self-audit command to verify sense is actually firing, since Knot skills load on semantic trigger, not as a platform-level hook), passive trigger judge (when to compress), partial reversible retrieval (recover only what's needed), and lean reply discipline (cut output tokens). Use when processing large files (500+ lines), long tool outputs, JSON arrays, build/test logs, search results, or when context window pressure is high. Also use when user asks to "compress context", "reduce tokens", "optimize context", "save tokens", "summarize output", "check if compression is actually working". skills.description_zh:
🔐 news-subscription-lite v1.0 — 安全人专属的「早报生成器」
每天早上醒来，不刷朋友圈、不打开 74 个网站，就能拿到一份今日安全圈发生了什么的结构化日报。

它做什么？
自动抓取 74 个信息源（央行/证监会/CNCERT 等官网 + 奇安信/360/长亭/Vulhub 等安全厂商 + 微信公众号）
自动打分 + 交叉验证，确保不是虚假信息或低质水文
一键输出 精炼 Markdown 日报，5 分钟读完今天的核心安全态势

3 步跑起来：
1、安装skill
2、cd ~/.workbuddy/skills/news-subscription-lite/scripts
3、python3 news_digest.py --mode daily
就这么简单。10 分钟出日报，20 分钟出周报。

适合谁？
金融机构安全运营/合规团队（央行动态、处罚信息实时跟踪）
安全负责人（每天看一份总结就够了，不用盯 74 个源）
甲方安全需要交「安全态势日报」的同学（直接改改就能用）
